professionalSummary: Phill Aelony is a Senior AI Engineer (his title: Generative AI Engineer at TimelyCare) based in Minneapolis, MN. He has shipped production software across web, mobile and cloud since 2021, his first software job; before that he taught himself to code (courses, and websites for his band and friends) while working as a professional musician. He owns greenfield platforms end to end, from stakeholder discovery to production, as engineer, designer and product manager in one, and builds LLM features into them: agents, MCP servers, streaming chat.
greeting: Greetings, traveler. The grove speaks through this old sage. Ask, and I shall answer in riddles.
fallbackLine: The grove's voice wearies, traveler — my riddles must rest. Yet the sacred mushroom remains. Seek me again when thee art ready.
triumphLines: The sporefall takes thee. Colors bloom — the walrus cries in joy.
Clam-song and cap-light: the grove rearranges itself around thy gaze.
Behold! The mycelial tide lifts every edge. Swim now, little seeker.
Enhanced. Thy vision now drinks the unseen spectrum of fruiting bodies.
The tusks of the deep one bless thy sight. Walk the bright grove.
declineLines: A wise caution. The fungi wait. The walrus dives another day.
No mushroom today. The grove respects the unhurried.
So be it. Perhaps when the third moon is a lasagna.
Declined with grace. The hyphae will remember.
Very well. The walrus winks and the grove hums on.
resumeDeclineLine: As thou wishest. The scroll keeps its secrets for another tide.
